tools.title: QPM Mod Menu
tools.description:
**QPM-GR** (Quinoa Pet Manager) is a companion userscript built around analytics: it tracks what your pets, crops and shops are actually doing, and automates the tedious parts.

- **Pet Hub** — overview, comparison and abilities tabs, with real-time proc rates per pet
- **Ability & XP trackers** — every proc logged as it happens, plus session XP/min and XP/hour
- **Shop Restock Tracker** — live tracking and statistical prediction, with countdown timers and dashboard cards
- **Auto-Favourite & Bulk Favourite** — rule-based locking by rarity, level or ability, so nothing gets sold by mistake
- **Turtle Timer, Weather Hub & Journal Checker** — growth and egg timings, mutation alerts, and journal completion progress

It runs on the same platforms as Arie's Mod (magiccircle.gg, magicgarden.gg, starweaver.org and Discord Activities) and exposes its data read-only through an *Aries Mod bridge*, so both can run side by side.

Install it with Tampermonkey or Violentmonkey, then open Magic Garden — the QPM panel appears in-game. Open source under the MIT licence.
